subject: Request: latest penetration test for hosted API + secure transfer
messages:
From: Grant Miller <grant.miller@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: latest penetration test for hosted API and transfer options

Hi Irene,

Can you send over your most recent penetration test report for the hosted API environment? Our auditors are scheduling a review next week and they asked for the latest external pen test plus a short remediation status summary for any high/critical findings.

A couple of clarifying items from our side:
- We need confirmation that the report scope covered the public hosted API endpoints and did not include customer data or internal-only networks.
- Two specific findings in our tracker (internal refs): CVE-2026-1001 and CVE-2026-2002 — can you confirm whether those are included and whether they are remediated?

Also advise on the preferred secure transfer method. We can accept either a short-lived presigned S3 link or an sFTP drop with one-time credentials. If we receive via presigned link, please set expiration to at least 48 hours (72 preferred). We will share the report with our external auditors (third-party), but please confirm any sharing restrictions or redactions you require.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Grant Miller
Senior Security Manager
Orbit Analytics
security@orbitanalytics.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Grant Miller <grant.miller@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test for hosted API and transfer options

Hi Grant — thanks for the note and the specifics. Short answers up front, details below: we can provide the 2026-10 external penetration test for the hosted API, we can share via presigned S3 with a 72-hour expiration, and we will include a remediation summary outlining status for the two CVEs you called out. We allow customers to share the report with their external auditors under the standard redaction policy (see below).

Scope and report content
- The delivered report is an external (black-box) assessment of the hosted API surface only. It does not include customer data, internal-only network scans, or source code.
- Executive summary + full findings (with CVSS and proof-of-concept) are included; detailed backend hostnames and internal IP addresses are redacted.

Remediation status (high-level)
- CVE-2026-1001: Confirmed in scope; remediation deployed to prod 2026-11-05. Patch and configuration changes included in remediation summary.
- CVE-2026-2002: In scope; fix scheduled and tested on staging. Production rollout planned for 2026-11-25 (hotfix window).

Secure transfer options
1) Presigned S3 link (recommended): single-use, download-only, custom expiration (we can do 72h). Access is logged (requester IP + timestamp).
2) sFTP account: one-time username/password + IP allowlist; credentials expire after first download or after 48h.
3) Virtual data room (for very sensitive requests) — requires paperwork and can take 2 business days to provision.

Redaction and auditor sharing
- We redact internal hostnames, internal IPs, and any PII from customer logs. We do not redact CVE details, exploit steps, or remediation recommendations. Customers may share the report with external auditors but must confirm they will not publish the raw report. If your auditors require a non-redacted copy, please have them sign our non-disclosure addendum; we can route that via your legal team.

If you confirm presigned S3 (72h) and confirm the auditors' email addresses, I will generate the link and attach the report + remediation spreadsheet.

Best,
Irene Choi
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Grant Miller <grant.miller@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@orbitanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test for hosted API and transfer options

Irene — thanks, presigned S3 with 72h expiry works for us.

A few follow-ups:
- Please include the remediation summary as a separate spreadsheet (we need itemized status).
- Confirm that the presigned link will be download-only (no list/browse) and provide audit logs showing IP + timestamp for downloads.
- Orbit's external auditors are: External Audit Group <audit@external-audit.com>. They should be permitted to download; please confirm if we need a signed NDA for that.
- We would prefer IP addresses redacted from the main report PDF — are the redactions you described consistent with that? We need to provide the redacted report to the auditors and keep an internal copy that includes internal IPs (we may request that later under NDA).

If you can confirm the above I will loop procurement if any paperwork is needed.

Grant
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Grant Miller <grant.miller@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test for hosted API and transfer options

Grant — confirmable on all points. Action items below and artifacts attached.

What we'll provide now
- redwood-hosted-penetration-report-2026-10.pdf (redacted for internal hostnames/IPs; CVE details retained)
- remediation-summary-ORB-2334.xlsx (row-level status for each finding; includes remediation dates and PR links)
- presigned S3 link: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/presigned/abc123 (download-only, single-use, expires 72 hours from creation)

Access controls and auditability
- The presigned object is configured for GET only (no list API).
- Access is logged; we will provide a CSV of access logs if you or your auditors request it. Logs include requester IP, timestamp, and user-agent.
- Sharing with External Audit Group <audit@external-audit.com> is permitted; no additional NDA required for the redacted report. For a non-redacted deliverable we require a signed non-disclosure addendum; procurement can route that to legal@redwood-inference.com.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-penetration-report-2026-10.pdf (redacted), remediation-summary-ORB-2334.xlsx

If you confirm receipt I will mark the HubSpot ticket HS-987654 as completed and send the access logs after the download occurs. Let us know if you want the non-redacted package — we can start the NDA process.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: [redwood-hosted-penetration-report-2026-10.pdf (application/pdf), remediation-summary-ORB-2334.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
